item.title: Glossary
item.description: Aberration An Eldertouched fusion of at least one monster and at least one human.

item.title: Aberration
item.description: An Eldertouched fusion of at least one monster and at least one human.

item.title: Abomination
item.description: A fusion of two or more Eldertouched monsters.

item.title: Elderbloom
item.description: Macroflora created from exposure to Eldertaint. Generally signify an area heavily affected by Eldertaint, and are likely to have Abominations nearby.

item.title: Eldertaint
item.description: A strange energy released by the primordial dragon Xeno'jiiva, which can radically alter any flora & fauna exposed to it in unpredictable ways.

item.title: Interspecies Abomination
item.description: Abominations caused by the fusion of two or more members of different species.

item.title: Intraspecies Abomination
item.description: Abominations caused by the fusion of two or more members of the same species.
